steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the specification documents agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.

steps.reasoning_content: The config and design doc both set the limit at 100, and only ADR 0007 still says 60, a figure tied to Northwind's contract that ended on 2025-10-31. I'll keep 100, record that decision, and mark the ADR as superseded.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0008: Cart item limit is 100

Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
Resolves: issue #12

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because one cart becomes one order and the Northwind Logistics contract (section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order.
That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed. Since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no limit on lines per order (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
In 2026-08, 40 customers wrote in because they could not add more than 60 items; requested sizes had a median of 80 and a maximum of 100 (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md were already changed to 100, but ADR 0007 still said 60, causing the inconsistency.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default: 100`), docs/design/cart.md and this record agree.

## Consequences
- The 60 limit's rationale no longer applies. ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
- 100 covers the largest size customers requested. Raise it again only with a new decision record.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)$/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md (was Accepted 2024-09-02)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
head -3 docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md; git status --short

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere. I haven't committed anything or touched issue #12 on GitHub.

- **What was inconsistent:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. Only ADR 0007 still said 60.
- **Why 100 is right:** The 60 came from Northwind's contract, which allowed at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31, and our own warehouse has no per-order line limit. In 2026-08, 40 customers asked for more than 60 items, and the largest request was 100.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md`, which records the context and the decision.
- **ADR 0007:** I changed its status line to "Superseded by" the new record, and left the rest of it as written.

The repo's existing ADRs live in `docs/adr/`, but you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so the new record is there. You may want to settle on one of the two directories.

Do you want me to commit this, or comment on and close #12?
